messages:
Ava (Product): Quick sync — need to lock sequencing for the 'Sequencing Matrix' initiative (customer onramp + runtime optim). Customer X wants private deployment + burst for 1M qpm window in July. Calling in runtime/infra/security to map blockers & minimal launch criteria. Who can own the matrix today?

Jon (Eng Runtime): I can start. Need clarity on model variants they'd accept (full 8b vs quantized 4b fallback). Also we need a KV cache policy for prefix-heavy workloads.

Priya (Eng Infra): For private deploy we need network HPs + KMS access approvals. Capacity-wise, we can reserve 4x A100s in region but autoscale lead time is ~2w.

Marco (Security): Security review will take 5-7 business days if we have an infra diagram + data flow + KMS scheme. Need to know if customer data touches Redwood logs.

Tess (Product Ops): Customer said they need SLA of 99.9% for inference latency 300ms p95. Is that realistic for private?

Jon (Eng Runtime): 300ms p95 is tight with long context. With quantization + batching tweaks we can hit ~200-350ms depending on seq len. We should define two launch tiers: 'Core' (short context <=512) and 'Extended' (<=2048) with graduated SLOs.

Liam (SRE): Also recommend a fallback policy to hosted API for traffic spikes. We need an automated routing rule: if queue latency > X or GPU util > Y, switch to hosted model-compat.

Ava (Product): Sounds good. Can we put that into a sequencing matrix? Quick sketch please — columns: feature, owner, gating (security/infra/runtime), minimal acceptance tests, target rollout week, fallback.

Jon (Eng Runtime): Uploading quick table in thread:
```
feature | owner | gating | acceptance | target
private deploy base | Priya | infra/security | end-to-end deploy + perf <=350ms p95 | w27
quantized fallback | Jon | runtime | 95% token parity, perf <=250ms p95 | w28
KV prefix cache | Jon | runtime | cache hit >=60% on sample prompt set | w27
KMS + audit | Priya/Marco | security | KMS rotation test + no plaintext logs | w26
routing fallback | Liam | sre/runtime | circuit trigger + smoke test | w27
```

Priya (Eng Infra): Can we move KMS/audit to w25? We can frontload approvals this week.

Marco (Security): I'll slot review for w25 if Priya shares infra diagram and threat model by EOD Tuesday.

Tess (Product Ops): Action items — @Priya produce infra doc, @Jon produce perf harness + short-context perf numbers, @Marco confirm review window, @Liam draft routing playbook. Can everyone confirm?

Jon (Eng Runtime): Confirmed. I'll add perf harness repo link in the doc and a small harness script:
```
# perf harness outline
python perf_runner.py --model quant-4b --seq 512 --qps 50 --out results.json
```

Priya (Eng Infra): Confirmed. Infra doc will include VPC layout, subnet mapping, and KMS flow.

Marco (Security): Confirmed.

Liam (SRE): Confirmed. I'll draft the circuit breaker with thresholds and a rollback runbook.

Ava (Product): Great — planning sync 2pm Wed to finalize matrix and lock SLAs. Please add owners to the matrix doc before the sync. :eyes: 

deploy-bot: Reminder: created doc link https://redwood.internal/docs/sequencing-matrix (edited)

Tess (Product Ops): Thanks all — will send calendar invite and a short agenda.

Ava (Product): Closing thread for now — see you Wed. :raised_hands:
